# Wikipedia articles (community pack)

**Today:** `HAXAppStoreService.loadBaseAppStore()` adds the Wikipedia app to every editor.

**As a plugin:** a pack holding that appstore fragment, unchanged (`registries/appstore/wikipedia.json`). The browser calls `en.wikipedia.org` directly, as it does today. Turning it on adds the app to the editor's app list. Turning it off removes the app, and content already inserted keeps working.

## Hooks and entry points
None. A pack is declarative: it contributes one appstore fragment.
